attribution: OSM route geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Height and clearance sampled against the local NTU Map terrain and voxel conversion.
description: Fictional students, cars, buses and traffic signals on mapped campus routes. Not live movement, real transport routes, timetables or people. Coordinates use unshifted NTU Map metres.
validation: Centre and both lane samples checked against actual converted mesh occupancy plus terrain. Source polylines retain previous OSM projection quantization, up to about one metre.
